action.message: Validation complete. The Smart City Hub installation via the guide's documented Docker Compose quickstart (`make up SCENARIO=data_store_backend`) is verified operational: container up with 0 restarts, healthz 200, Swagger 200, data API correctly enforcing Basic auth and round-tripping data end-to-end with persistence to the mounted volume.
